summary.evidence: Safwan Adnan, WhatFlow co-founder and CEO, confirmed on 2026-10-26 that WhatFlow Business API's inbox is enterprise-ready, with AI excluded. This founder clarification does not independently establish named certifications, specific governance controls, SLAs or individual feature parity. Keep this evidence date in the audit record rather than repeating it in public prose.
